scenes.title: Hook
scenes.vo: Heritage Timber faux wood beams, from Ekena Millwork. Here's every texture, finish, and size.

scenes.title: Textures
scenes.vo: Each texture is molded from real, weathered timber. | Mena. | Salvaged Timber. | Rustic Sawn. | Resawn Rip. | Reclaimed Axed Cut. | And Sanded Smooth.

scenes.title: Finishes
scenes.vo: Then pick a hand-stained finish. | Sandstone. | Kona Brown. | Vanilla Chai. | Warm Caramel. | Natural White Oak. | Smokey Brown. | Or primed, ready to paint or stain.

scenes.title: Every combination
scenes.vo: Five textures come in every finish. Sanded Smooth comes primed.

scenes.title: Sizes
scenes.vo: There are eight sizes, from three and a half inches square, up to nine and a half by eleven and a half.

scenes.title: Inside opening
scenes.vo: Check the inside opening. That's what slides over your mounting block. Cut the block an eighth of an inch narrower than the inside width.

scenes.title: Lengths
scenes.vo: Lengths run from four feet to twenty-four feet.

scenes.title: Quick Ship
scenes.vo: Stained beams usually ship in three to five business days. Primed beams, in about one to three days. Endcaps are sold separately, unstained, so you can finish them to match.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.vo: Not sure on the finish? Order a sample first.
